question: List the title and price of all Sci-Fi books, ordered by price from highest to lowest.
reference_sql: SELECT title, price FROM books WHERE genre = 'Sci-Fi' ORDER BY price DESC;

question: What is the total stock of all books published after 2020?
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(stock) FROM books WHERE published_year > 2020;

question: List the names of all authors from Nigeria.
reference_sql: SELECT name FROM authors WHERE country = 'Nigeria';

question: For each genre, what is the average book price, rounded to 2 decimal places? Order by genre name.
reference_sql: SELECT genre, ROUND(AVG(price), 2) AS avg_price FROM books GROUP BY genre ORDER BY genre;

question: Which customers have placed more than 2 orders? List their name and order count.
reference_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id HAVING COUNT(o.id) > 2;

question: What is the total revenue (quantity times unit price) from shipped orders only, rounded to 2 decimals?
reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'shipped';

question: List the top 3 books by total quantity sold across all orders, from most to least.
reference_sql: SELECT b.title, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_qty FROM order_items oi JOIN books b ON b.id = oi.book_id GROUP BY b.id ORDER BY total_qty DESC LIMIT 3;

question: List the distinct names of customers who have at least one cancelled order.
reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.status = 'cancelled';

question: What is the title and author name of the single most expensive book?
reference_sql: SELECT b.title, a.name FROM books b JOIN authors a ON a.id = b.author_id ORDER BY b.price DESC LIMIT 1;

question: List each author's name and how many books they've written, only for authors with more than 1 book, ordered by book count descending then name ascending.
reference_sql: SELECT a.name, COUNT(b.id) AS book_count FROM authors a JOIN books b ON b.author_id = a.id GROUP BY a.id HAVING COUNT(b.id) > 1 ORDER BY book_count DESC, a.name ASC;

question: List the titles of Mystery books priced above 16, ordered by price from lowest to highest.
reference_sql: SELECT title FROM books WHERE genre = 'Mystery' AND price > 16 ORDER BY price ASC;

question: How many Poetry books are there?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM books WHERE genre = 'Poetry';

question: What is the average price of Fantasy books, rounded to 2 decimal places?
reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(price), 2) FROM books WHERE genre = 'Fantasy';

question: What is the highest stock level among books published in 2023?
reference_sql: SELECT MAX(stock) FROM books WHERE published_year = 2023;

question: List the name and email of every customer who signed up in 2022.
reference_sql: SELECT name, email FROM customers WHERE signup_date LIKE '2022-%';

question: List the titles of books with fewer than 10 copies in stock.
reference_sql: SELECT title FROM books WHERE stock < 10;

question: List the titles of books published between 2018 and 2020, inclusive.
reference_sql: SELECT title FROM books WHERE published_year BETWEEN 2018 AND 2020;

question: How many orders currently have the status 'placed'?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'placed';

question: For each order status, how many orders have that status? Return the status and the count.
reference_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY status;

question: For each customer country, how many customers are there? Return the country and the count.
reference_sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY country;

question: Which genres have more than 4 books? Return the genre and its number of books.
reference_sql: SELECT genre, COUNT(*) FROM books GROUP BY genre HAVING COUNT(*) > 4;

question: List the titles of all books written by Kenji Watanabe.
reference_sql: SELECT b.title FROM books b JOIN authors a ON a.id = b.author_id WHERE a.name = 'Kenji Watanabe';

question: For every book priced above 20, list its title and its author's country.
reference_sql: SELECT b.title, a.country FROM books b JOIN authors a ON a.id = b.author_id WHERE b.price > 20;

question: For each author country, what is the total stock of books by authors from that country? Return the country and the total stock.
reference_sql: SELECT a.country, SUM(b.stock) FROM books b JOIN authors a ON a.id = b.author_id GROUP BY a.country;

question: How many books were written by authors from China?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM books b JOIN authors a ON a.id = b.author_id WHERE a.country = 'China';

question: List the distinct titles of books that appear in any order placed by Hana Suzuki.
reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT b.title FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN books b ON b.id = oi.book_id WHERE c.name = 'Hana Suzuki';

question: What is the total value (quantity times unit price) of all orders placed by Diego Fernandez, including cancelled ones, rounded to 2 decimals?
reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE c.name = 'Diego Fernandez';

question: For each genre, what is the total revenue (quantity times unit price) across all orders of any status, rounded to 2 decimals? Return the genre and the revenue.
reference_sql: SELECT b.genre, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) FROM order_items oi JOIN books b ON b.id = oi.book_id GROUP BY b.genre;

question: Which customer has the highest total spend (quantity times unit price) on shipped orders only? Return the name and the total rounded to 2 decimals.
reference_sql: SELECT c.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS total FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'shipped' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How many distinct customers have at least one shipped order?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM orders WHERE status = 'shipped';

question: List the title and price of every book priced above the average price of all books.
reference_sql: SELECT title, price FROM books WHERE price > (SELECT AVG(price) FROM books);

question: List the names of customers who have never had a cancelled order.
reference_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled');

question: List the titles of books that never appear in a cancelled order.
reference_sql: SELECT title FROM books WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT oi.book_id FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'cancelled');

question: How many orders were placed from January 1 to March 31, 2023, inclusive?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-03-31';

question: For each month of 2023, how many orders were placed? Return the month formatted as 'YYYY-MM' and the count, ordered by month.
reference_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date LIKE '2023-%' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;

question: What are the titles of the 5 cheapest books, from cheapest to most expensive?
reference_sql: SELECT title FROM books ORDER BY price ASC LIMIT 5;

question: What is the title of the book with the lowest stock?
reference_sql: SELECT title FROM books ORDER BY stock ASC LIMIT 1;

question: List the titles of the book or books with the most recent publication year. If several books share that year, list all of them.
reference_sql: SELECT title FROM books WHERE published_year = (SELECT MAX(published_year) FROM books);

question: List the names of authors who have written exactly 3 books.
reference_sql: SELECT a.name FROM authors a JOIN books b ON b.author_id = a.id GROUP BY a.id HAVING COUNT(*) = 3;

question: Count the books in each price band: 'budget' for price under 12, 'standard' for price from 12 up to but not including 20, and 'premium' for price 20 or more. Return the band name and the count.
reference_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN price < 12 THEN 'budget' WHEN price < 20 THEN 'standard' ELSE 'premium' END AS band, COUNT(*) FROM books GROUP BY band;

question: On average, how many copies (sum of quantity) does an order contain? Round to 2 decimal places.
reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(quantity) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 2) FROM order_items;

question: List the ids of orders that contain more than one distinct book, ordered by id.
reference_sql: SELECT order_id FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT book_id) > 1 ORDER BY order_id;

question: What is the total number of copies of Sci-Fi books sold across all orders of any status?
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi JOIN books b ON b.id = oi.book_id WHERE b.genre = 'Sci-Fi';

question: Which customers have spent more than 50 in total (quantity times unit price) across all their orders of any status? Return the name and the total rounded to 2 decimals.
reference_sql: SELECT c.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id GROUP BY c.id HAVING SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) > 50;

question: For each customer country, how many orders were placed by customers from that country? Return the country and the number of orders.
reference_sql: SELECT c.country, COUNT(o.id) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.country;

question: List the names of customers who live in a country that is also the country of at least one author.
reference_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE country IN (SELECT country FROM authors);

question: What is the earliest signup date among customers from the UK?
reference_sql: SELECT MIN(signup_date) FROM customers WHERE country = 'UK';

question: List the customer name and order date of every order placed in June 2023, ordered by order date.
reference_sql: SELECT c.name, o.order_date FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_date LIKE '2023-06-%' ORDER BY o.order_date;

question: For each customer, how many copies (sum of quantity) have they bought in orders that were not cancelled? Return the customer name and the total, only for customers with a total above 0.
reference_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.quantity) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.id;

question: What percentage of all orders have the status 'cancelled'? Round to 1 decimal place (for example 25.0).
reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) FROM orders;

question: Which genre has the highest average book price? Return only the genre name.
reference_sql: SELECT genre FROM books GROUP BY genre ORDER BY AVG(price) DESC LIMIT 1;

question: List the names of authors whose books have sold more than 5 copies in total across all orders of any status.
reference_sql: SELECT a.name FROM authors a JOIN books b ON b.author_id = a.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.book_id = b.id GROUP BY a.id HAVING SUM(oi.quantity) > 5;

question: List each order id together with its total value (quantity times unit price) rounded to 2 decimals, only for orders whose total value is above 40.
reference_sql: SELECT order_id, ROUND(SUM(quantity * unit_price), 2) FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id HAVING SUM(quantity * unit_price) > 40;

question: What is the title of the second most expensive book?
reference_sql: SELECT title FROM books ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1;

question: How many different authors have written at least one Sci-Fi book?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT author_id) FROM books WHERE genre = 'Sci-Fi';

question: List the titles of books whose title starts with the word 'The'.
reference_sql: SELECT title FROM books WHERE title LIKE 'The %';

question: For each publication year that has 2 or more books, how many books were published that year? Return the year and the count.
reference_sql: SELECT published_year, COUNT(*) FROM books GROUP BY published_year HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2;

question: List the distinct names of customers who ordered at least one book written by an author from the same country as the customer.
reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN books b ON b.id = oi.book_id JOIN authors a ON a.id = b.author_id WHERE a.country = c.country;

question: What is the total value (quantity times unit price) of all orders of any status placed by customers from the UK, rounded to 2 decimals?
reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE c.country = 'UK';

question: List the genres that have no book appearing in any order with status 'placed'.
reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT genre FROM books WHERE genre NOT IN (SELECT b.genre FROM books b JOIN order_items oi ON oi.book_id = b.id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'placed');
